source_caption_text:
Yeat’s NPC is really fluent in adlibs 😭😂😂

Who is copping the bundle??

The crossover arrives in the Item Shop tonight, October 15, at 8 p.m. ET, following the reveal of the “Real Lyfe” trailer. The release includes two outfits, two back blings and two emotes, alongside additional accessories inspired by Yeat’s aesthetic. It’s a major expansion of his presence in the game after his earlier music-based cosmetics. 

The designs draw from his recognizable wardrobe, including beanies, sunglasses, chains and tattoos, with green reactive effects adding to the futuristic look. Additional items expected in the collection include a pickaxe, microphone instrument, wrap and kicks, bringing more of his visual world into Fortnite. 

The music is a big part of the release too. “Gët Busy,” “Monëy So Big” and “If We Being Rëal” are joining as Jam Tracks, connecting songs from his breakout period with the sound of his 2093 era. Fans will be able to bring those records into Fortnite’s music experience alongside the new cosmetics.
